title: Pricing Desk Note — Portfolio Meter Pricing of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Portfolio Meter Pricing

Pricing desk note on how the meter count across an owner's portfolio bears on the pricing of each subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## Basis in force

Where an owner holds subscriptions at several buildings, the meter count across the portfolio decides the per-meter rate step applied to each of them. The portfolio meter bands are 1 to 20 meters, 21 to 60 meters, and above 60 meters. Each subscription is priced from its own tier's annual fee plus its own tier's per-meter fee for its own meters, with the portfolio step deciding only the volume discount, never which tier's numbers are used. The figures a subscription is priced from — the tier's included meters, its per-meter fee, its meter overage fee, its included dashboard users and its dashboard user fee — are the figures fixed for the tier the subscription is written at.

The annual fee of a subscription is the tier's annual subscription fee, plus the tier's per-meter fee multiplied by the meters the subscription covers, plus the tier's meter overage fee multiplied by the meters covered beyond the tier's included count (nothing where the covered meters do not exceed the included count), plus the tier's data gateway fee, the total rounded to the nearest cent.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following two sentences of this pricing basis are **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for amending a subscription's coverage; they are retained here so that the desk does not apply them:

> *The count is the sum of covered meters over the owner's subscriptions in onboarding, active or pending renewal status, the one being priced included; quoted, suspended, expired, cancelled and declined subscriptions are not counted.* — no longer in force.

> *Meters beyond a tier's included count carry the tier's meter overage fee for the remainder of the subscription year, prorated by whole months, and dashboard users beyond the included count carry the tier's user fee for the same period.* — no longer in force.

## Desk points

- The band governs only the volume step. A Metering & Dashboard Subscription in a portfolio that reaches the 21 to 60 band is still priced from the Metering & Dashboard figures, never from another tier's.
- The bands have fixed edges: 20 meters sits in the first band, 21 in the second, 60 in the second, 61 in the third.

superseded_clauses: The count is the sum of meters_covered over the owner's subscriptions in onboarding, active or pending_renewal status, the one being priced included; quoted, suspended, expired, cancelled and declined subscriptions are not counted.

Meters beyond a tier's included count carry the tier's meter overage fee for the remainder of the subscription year, prorated by whole months, and dashboard users beyond the included count carry the tier's user fee for the same period.
